483-2301-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:

When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Dormant Volcano

Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

1580-4871-5670-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.

1580-4871-5670-5931.description:

When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Funeral Room and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2464-3249-6112--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3249-6112--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-6112--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill 5 cards.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill 5 cards.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2263-6495-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1765-5972-8095.notablePrerequisites:

When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2292-2728-4153-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.

2292-2728-4153-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2292-2728-4153-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

676-1987-4477.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1987-4477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1987-4477.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1987-4477.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.

4390-5078-5645-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-5078-5645-6757-7633.description:

Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3490-5468-6996.description:
Gain life.

The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1879-3259-4373.description:

Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine

Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.

The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-5972-6054.notablePrerequisites:

Repeat.

Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.

Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.

Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic, adding {R}.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Body Double, adding {R}.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3372-4050-4068-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.

549-5522-5747.description:
Cast Essence of the Wild by paying {3}{G}{G}{G}.
When Essence of the Wild enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference, Simulacrum Synthesizer's second ability triggers, creating a 0/0 Contruct artifact creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
When the Essence of the Wild token enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference, Simulacrum Synthesizer's second ability triggers, creating a 0/0 Contruct artifact creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Repeat step 3.
549-5522-5747.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop at step 3 which will cause the game to end in a draw if it is not interacted with. It is highly recommend to somehow interact with the combo once you have achieved your desired result.

uses.n: Ratchet, Field Medic // Ratchet, Rescue Racer

1818-4605-5118-5144.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
1818-4605-5118-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Ratchet, causing it to enter the battlefield as Ratchet, Field Medic.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Preston and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ratchet, Field Medic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
When the Ratchet, Field Medic token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
The Ratchet, Field Medic token triggers, causing you to convert it into Ratchet, Rescue Racer, and return Ratchet from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Preston and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ratchet, Field Medic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
The Ratchet, Rescue Racer token triggers, as well as Healer of the Pride.
Resolve the Ratchet, Rescue Racer trigger, causing you to convert it into Ratchet, Field Medic.
Put one of the Ratchet, Field Medic tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 7.

1093-1329-3363.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1093-1329-3363.description:
Activate Phyrexia's Core's second ability by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing The One Ring, causing you to gain one life.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

1771-3096-4400.notablePrerequisites: Hermit Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1771-3096-4400.description:
Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}, searching for all lands in your library, exiling them and shuffling your library.
Activate Hermit Druid by paying {G} and tapping it, causing you to mill your entire library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.
